name: opencode-web-demo
description: OpenCode Web 的 Electron 桌面壳

scripts.electron:dev: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && (vite & VITE_PID=$!; trap 'kill $VITE_PID' EXIT; electron . --dev)
scripts.electron:package: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && node scripts/bundle-opencode-cli.mjs && ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder
scripts.electron:package:linux: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && OPENCODE_TARGET=linux-x64 node scripts/bundle-opencode-cli.mjs && ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64
scripts.electron:package:win: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && OPENCODE_TARGET=windows-x64 node scripts/bundle-opencode-cli.mjs && ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win --x64
